lede: Detroit Lions carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#4 in EPA per play), while Minnesota Vikings owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#1 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Detroit Lions −5.5 with a fair total of 44.5 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Minnesota Vikings pass offence vs Detroit Lions pass defence, which sits −0.186 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Minnesota Vikings and Detroit Lions have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
